parent_objective: synthesize fidelity fault source branch evidence after four-wheel source-positive corpus export
blocked_by: M1274 routes to branch synthesis because the fidelity fault source branch reached synthesis cadence
supersedes: another narrow four-wheel source experiment before synthesis

public_gates: M1275 must preserve actor input contract
M1275 must not use private holdout
M1275 must not promote a checkpoint
M1275 must choose continue, pivot, stop, or promote_to_next_branch
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters, fault labels, per-wheel forces, oracle outcomes, or search outputs to actor inputs
do not start another source run before synthesis
do not claim compact four-wheel source as high-fidelity validation

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: synthesizes M1265-M1274 fidelity fault source evidence and chooses the next branch decision
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: branch synthesis only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the branch did not produce source-positive rows
stop if next proposal is just another source-grid tweak without using the exported corpus
stop if next step would require actor-input expansion
fallback_plan: if synthesis supports continuation, promote to a source-to-intervention/materialization branch
if synthesis finds the source corpus unsuitable, route to source-corpus repair or stop
if synthesis finds high-fidelity limits dominate, pivot to external dynamics validation design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1265-M1274 reaches the branch synthesis cadence after M1273 exports a source-positive four-wheel corpus

admission_evidence: M1274 routes to synthesis before the next narrow source step
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next-branch manifest if synthesis admits it
next_stage_criteria: synthesis chooses continue, pivot, stop, or promote_to_next_branch
next branch has a new evidence variable if any run is admitted

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1275 synthesizes offline source evidence and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until synthesis routes the source corpus to an intervention or replay design
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Aggregate M1265-M1274 evidence before starting another narrow experiment.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, true high-fidelity fault, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The fidelity fault source branch has enough evidence for branch-level synthesis before any further source experiment.
success_criteria: synthesis records supported and falsified claims
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: synthesis admits another narrow source run without a branch decision
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1275 passes if it synthesizes M1265-M1274 evidence and chooses a next branch without training or threshold relaxation.
